Treatment summary
The patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with symptoms consistent with concussion, including
headache, dizziness, light sensitivity, and difficulty concentrating. The mechanism of injury is well matched to the reported force
and direction of the crash. Over the course of sixteen visits, care followed a typical progression of graded symptom monitoring,
vestibular and cognitive rest with gradual return to activity, and targeted exercises for balance and visual tracking. Frequency of
visits tapered steadily as symptoms resolved and functional measures improved. Imaging and neurological examination findings
clearly confirm the diagnosis. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known from the patient's history or available records.
Billed services correspond to the clinical care documented, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. The patient was
discharged to self-directed activity with instructions to report any recurrence of symptoms.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
